subject: Plexion renewal: one-time credit + SLA overlay request
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Plexion renewal - ask for one-time credit + SLA overlay

Team,

Quick context: Plexion (annual sub, $620k ARR) indicated they will not renew under the current terms; procurement surfaced pricing pressure after a competitor quoted a 25% discount. They've been a good strategic reference (marketplace integration + potential joint webinar) but we risk a churn that would be high-impact for our Q3 numbers.

What I need from leadership / deal desk: approval for the following emergency offer to close renewal this week:
- One-time account credit: $75,000 applied pro rata across the 12-month renewal (reflects a ~12% concession)
- Term reset: restart 12-month term effective on signing (customer asked for shorter term, we want to lock)
- SLA overlay: 99.9% uptime guarantee for production endpoints + one-time SLA credit of 20% (if not met in the first 6 months)

Rationale:
- Customer committed to doubling usage in H2 if we keep current price competitiveness (they presented a roadmap dependent on our latency guarantees).
- Loss would risk a negative case study and could slow our marketplace dynamics.

Attachments: ply_deal_summary_2027-07.pdf and usage_history_q2_2027.csv (see metrics).

If we approve, next steps: legal to produce amendment, finance to accept amortization/clawback language. Asking for decision by EOD so I can present to Plexion procurement tomorrow.

Thanks,
David
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:05:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Plexion renewal - ask for one-time credit + SLA overlay

David—

Thanks for the summary. I support an aggressive retention posture here but need to flag two controls: finance will want a mechanism to recover value if usage falls (clawback), and legal will want the SLA language scoped clearly (only production endpoints for the marketplace integration, exclude dev/test).

If leadership is comfortable, my recommendation is a mitigated counter-offer that balances keep/discipline:
- One-time credit: $50k (instead of $75k)
- Term reset: 12 months, but credit amortized monthly over first 6 months with a 50% clawback if monthly usage drops >40% below baseline for any two consecutive months
- SLA overlay: approve 99.9% for production endpoints; SLA credit tied to the standard schedule but capped at one invoice cycle (we should not open a multi-month credit exposure)

Please include projected revenue delta (net present value) and the proposed customer commitment language (e.g., minimum monthly spend or expansion milestone). I can push to finance and legal once we have leadership concurrence.

-Monica
Director, Deal Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 13:30:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Plexion renewal - ask for one-time credit + SLA overlay

Folks—

Given the strategic nature (marketplace reference + public joint go-to-market), I lean toward approving the larger concession now to avoid the churn and the potential negative momentum. Churn risk for this account is > 60% if we do not present a significantly better economic option in the next 48 hours.

I will sign off on the full $75k one-time credit + the 99.9% SLA overlay under the following firm conditions:
1) Customer signs amendment within 5 business days
2) Credit amortized monthly and subject to a 6-month clawback tied to minimum usage thresholds (finance to define)
3) Marketing commit to a joint case study or webinar as part of the renewal (value exchange)

If Laura can provide quick approval on the principle, legal and finance can work the language. This is time-sensitive — losing Plexion now will be noisier than the concession.

-Vivek
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Plexion renewal - ask for one-time credit + SLA overlay

Appreciate the quick context and recommendations. Approve the concession on a conditional basis:

Decision: Approve $75,000 one-time credit and 99.9% SLA overlay for production endpoints.
Conditions to execute:
- Credit amortized over the first 6 invoices and recoverable (100% clawback) if Plexion reduces usage >50% below the Q2 baseline within any rolling 3-month window in the first 6 months.
- Legal to produce an amendment tagging the SLA to specific endpoints and limiting credit exposure to the first 6 months (no open multi-quarter liability).
- Customer must sign within 5 business days and commit to a joint marketing activity (case study or webinar) to be delivered within 6 months.
- Finance to confirm accounting treatment and revenue impact; deal desk to record concession in the HubSpot record.

Monica / Vivek: please push legal & finance today and provide me a one-pager outlining the final offer and the proposed clawback metric. I will approve the amendment sign-off once that is attached.

-Laura Bennett
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared@plexion.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@plexion.com>, Renata Soto <renata.soto@plexion.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Plexion renewal - revised offer (requires signature within 5 business days)

Jared / Renata / Plexion procurement—

Thanks for the candid conversation today. We value Plexion as a strategic partner and want to keep you on the platform. Based on internal approvals, here is the revised offer we can sign this week: 

Offer summary:
- One-time account credit: $75,000 applied to invoices across the first 6 months of the renewal (amortized monthly)
- Term: 12-month renewal, effective on signature (full term reset)
- SLA overlay: 99.9% uptime guarantee scoped to production endpoints as defined in the attached amendment; if SLA is not met within the first 6 months, Plexion will be eligible for up to one invoice credit per the schedule in the amendment (capped)
- Clawback: credit recoverable in full if Plexion’s monthly usage drops >50% below the Q2 2027 baseline for any rolling 3-month period in the first 6 months (details in amendment)
- Marketing: Plexion to participate in a co-branded case study or webinar within 6 months of signing (mutual dates to be agreed)

Attached: plexion_amendment_v3.docx (redlines SLA and clawback language); ply_deal_summary_2027-07.pdf; usage_history_q2_2027.csv

Next steps: sign and return the attached amendment within 5 business days. If you need a short call to review, I can be available tomorrow morning PST.

Appreciate the partnership—looking forward to getting this across the line.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: plexion_amendment_v3.docx (docx), ply_deal_summary_2027-07.pdf (pdf), usage_history_q2_2027.csv (csv)
